mapper.select: select id, delivery_id, hr_id, interviewer, interview_time, duration, location, address_detail, contact_person, contact_phone, remark, status, feedback, create_time, update_time from interview where id = #{id}

select i.id, i.delivery_id, i.hr_id, i.interviewer, i.interview_time, i.duration, i.location, i.address_detail, i.contact_person, i.contact_phone, i.remark, i.status, i.feedback, i.create_time, i.update_time, j.title as job_title, c.company_name, r.name as candidate_name from interview i left join delivery d on d.id = i.delivery_id left join job j on j.id = d.job_id left join company c on c.id = j.company_id left join resume r on r.id = d.resume_id where i.id = #{id}

select i.id, i.delivery_id, i.hr_id, i.interviewer, i.interview_time, i.duration, i.location, i.address_detail, i.contact_person, i.contact_phone, i.remark, i.status, i.feedback, i.create_time, i.update_time, j.title as job_title, c.company_name, r.name as candidate_name from interview i left join delivery d on d.id = i.delivery_id left join job j on j.id = d.job_id left join company c on c.id = j.company_id left join resume r on r.id = d.resume_id where d.user_id = #{userId} order by i.interview_time desc

select i.id, i.delivery_id, i.hr_id, i.interviewer, i.interview_time, i.duration, i.location, i.address_detail, i.contact_person, i.contact_phone, i.remark, i.status, i.feedback, i.create_time, i.update_time, j.title as job_title, c.company_name, r.name as candidate_name from interview i left join delivery d on d.id = i.delivery_id left join job j on j.id = d.job_id left join company c on c.id = j.company_id left join resume r on r.id = d.resume_id inner join `user` u on u.id = d.user_id and u.status = 1 where i.hr_id = #{hrId} order by i.interview_time desc
mapper.update: update interview set status = #{status}, feedback = #{feedback}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
